Hi Sylvia —

Thanks again for confirming interest in a Dedicated/private deployment deep-dive. To make sure the regional security reviewers can join without forcing anyone to join at 02:00 local time, we sketched two staggered windows with a short overlap so the Red Team and your reviewers can hand off live context. Attached: Proposed_windows_v1.ics and a short checklist.

Proposed (all approximate):
- Option A (single staggered session):
  * US engineering + product: 09:00–10:30 PT (16:00–17:30 CET / next day 00:00–01:30 SGT) — US + partial EU overlap at the start
  * EU DPO joins first 45m (16:00–16:45 CET) for the compliance walkthrough
  * APAC security reviewer joins the latter 45m (00:45–01:30 SGT) for deployment/ops questions
- Option B (two short focused sessions):
  * EU session: 15:00–16:15 CET (US: 06:00–07:15 PT) — EU DPO + Red Team deep-dive
  * APAC session: 23:30–00:30 SGT (US: 08:30–09:30 PT) — APAC lead + ops handoff

Can you check which approach would be easier for your EU DPO (Eva Novak) and APAC security (Tom Hsu)? If you prefer, we can split into two 45-minute calls and record a liaison overlap.

Quick asks: please confirm Eva and Tom’s preferred window, and whether they need any pre-read (I can share a focused checklist).

Thanks —

> Thanks again for confirming interest in a Dedicated/private deployment deep-dive.

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear options. Eva (our EU DPO) asked to be included and flagged two constraints:
- She cannot join before 15:00 CET because of back-to-back regulator check-ins on Thursdays.
- From our side, Tom (APAC) is usually available after 22:00 CET (07:00 SGT next day), and he prefers a single joined session if the overlap is at least 30m so he can hear the compliance summary live.

Given that, Option A with a 16:00–16:45 CET slot for Eva and APAC joining late works if we push the start 45m later (so Eva still has time after her 15:00 commitments). Alternatively, Option B with two focused sessions (EU then APAC) is simpler for internal scheduling.

Eva asked for the pre-read (DPA excerpt + network isolation diagram). Could you send a 1-page summary for her review? Also adding a HubSpot link for the deal in case we need to attach procurement notes.
